title: Projection onto a code fixes its own vectors
statement: Let $C$ be a subspace of the $n$-qubit Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_n$, and let $P_C : \mathcal{H}_n \to \mathcal{H}_n$ be the orthogonal projection onto $C$. If $x \in C$, then $P_C x = x$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a subspace of the n-qubit Hilbert space
